versions.content: {DRAFT} A PNC shall reference the same ComM channel exclusively either by using ComMChannelPerPnc or ComMChannelPerTxOnlyPnc. Otherwise the configuration is invalid. A configuration tool shall reject such a configuration as invalid (error).

If a PNC references a ComM channel, then this PNC shall reference that ComM channel either using ComMChannelPerPnc or ComMChannelPerTxOnlyPnc, but not both. Otherwise the configuration is invalid. A configuration tool shall reject such a configuration as invalid (error).
